crossRefs.note: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat…
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor…
Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…
and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them…
